therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD20/CD3 bispecific T-cell engagement, TIGIT checkpoint inhibition, PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell mediated B-cell lymphoma killing with enhanced immune activation

results.target_engagement_evidence: Mosunetuzumab serum concentrations achieved measurable levels with accumulation over cycles (peak ~4 ug/mL at C2D1)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events: abdominal pain, diarrhea, COVID-19, aspiration pneumonia, septic shock, fall, cerebellar hematoma
results.dose_information: Subcutaneous mosunetuzumab, IV tiragolumab Q3W, IV atezolizumab Q3W for up to 17 cycles (21-day cycles)

context.duration: Up to 17 cycles (21 days each), terminated early
